newsitem.title: UK: IGC sees steady 96-97 wheat trade, Iran imports up.
newsitem.headline: IGC sees steady 96-97 wheat trade, Iran imports up.

text.p: The International Grains Council on Thursday left its estimate for world wheat trade in 1996-97 unchanged at 91 million tonnes, compared with a 1995-96 figure of 89 million.
But it saw a sharp rise in Iran's imports to 6.6 million tonnes, from 5.0 million tonnes estimated last month.
In its latest monthly report, it trimmed its estimate for China's wheat imports to 3.6 million tonnes from 4.0 million previously.

Of the major wheat exporting countries, the IGC raised its estimate for Argentina to 10.6 million tonnes from 10 million, for the EU to 16 million from 15.5 million and for the US to 26 million from 25.5 million tonnes. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
